pins.definition: Something given to someone willingly as a sign of affection or to celebrate an occasion.
Something that you give to someone, especially on a special occasion or to thank them.
Something given to someone without payment, especially on a special occasion.

situation: A woman hands a wrapped box tied with a bright ribbon across a wooden counter to a smiling friend.
subject: the wrapped gift
brief: A woman's hands extend a brightly wrapped cardboard box tied with a broad red ribbon across a clean wooden tabletop toward a delighted man. The package is the brightest, most sharply lit object in the frame, angled so the bow catches the eye instantly.
prompt: A woman's hands extend a brightly wrapped cardboard box tied with a broad red ribbon across a clean wooden tabletop toward a delighted man. The package is the brightest, most sharply lit object in the frame, angled so the bow catches the eye instantly. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
